basic_info.profile_name: International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad (IIITH)
basic_info.description: International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIIT-H) is an autonomous university, founded as a not-for-profit public private partnership (N-PPP) in 1998, and is the first IIIT in India under this model. Over the years, the institute has evolved strong research programmes in various areas, with an emphasis on technology and applied research for industry and society. The institute facilitates interdisciplinary research and a seamless flow of knowledge. Several world-renowned centres of excellence are part of IIITH’s research portfolio. It has established various joint collaboration and co-innovation models with an industry outreach spanning significant national and multinational companies. Its innovative curriculum allows students the flexibility of selecting their courses and projects. Apart from academics the institute provides students with a comprehensive environment that promotes art and culture, sports, societal contributions and self-governance. Even undergraduate students get to participate in ongoing research and technology development - an opportunity unprecedented in India. As a result, a vibrant undergraduate programme co-exists along with a strong postgraduate programme.

basic_info.name: Shaastra, IIT Madras
basic_info.description: Shaastra means science. The word has a deeper connotation here, being the annual technical festival of the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. It has now become an integral part of the institute’s culture, exhibiting engineering grandeur in an intellectual carnival of people with visionaries, academia and industrialists. Shaastra provides its sponsors and partners with a unique opportunity for publicity and branding in a vibrant intellectually stimulating atmosphere.Shaastra has the distinction of being the first student-organized event in the world to be ISO 9001:2008 certified, for its impeccable planning, innovation and execution. The competitions at Shaastra boast of having the highest number of outstation participants from India as well as abroad, for any festival of its kind. Over the years, Shaastra has received accolades and appreciation from the industry, academia and media alike.As always, Shaastra aims to grow and evolve into a technical festival which involves everyone – be it budding engineers, young entrepreneurs, future policy “Igniting Imagination” and thereby to promote innovation and creative thinking. As part of this agenda, Shaastra aims at making a huge difference to both technology and society by translating ideas into real world solutions. Shaastra will also showcase cutting-edge technologies through channels like the Industrial Open House and the Research Expo to inspire student community to embrace innovative thought.

basic_info.name: Saarang, IIT Madras
basic_info.description: Saarang, the annual cultural festival of IIT Madras, is the largest student-run festival in India and the second oldest college festival in India. Since its humble beginnings as Mardi Gras, the fest has set the standard for cultural festivals all over, with Saarang's latest edition seeing 80,000 visitors from across the country partaking in the dynamic events over the course of 5 days. The nights at Saarang have witnessed phenomenal performances from both eminent Indian artists including Shankar Ehsaan Loy, Sunidhi Chauhan, Sid Sriram, Amit Trivedi and Shobana and famed international artists like Opeth, AronChupa, Dubvision, and Katatonia.  Saarang aims to give back to society and has reached out to its surrounding community through its social campaigns over the years. Follow our page for regular updates. You can also find us on Instagram, Facebook, Twitter and YouTube.Reach us at:Jasman Kaur | +91 62809 24060Keshav Garodia | +91 86177 75132Poras Wadhai | +91 91758 89523sponsorship@saarang.org

basic_info.name: Digio.in
basic_info.description: Digio provides the ultimate digital infrastructure for trust, enabling businesses to execute securely, compliantly, and effortlessly at any scale.Founded in 2016, Digio helps organizations transition to paperless and presence-less workflows by digitizing onboarding, documentation, signing, and payments. Digio serves 2000+ businesses, including leading banks and fintech companies in India, and processes millions of transactions every month.Digio’s platform supports the full customer lifecycle through a unified product stack:DigiKYC: Digital identity verification and end-to-end KYCDigiDocs: Document automation with templates, workflows, and e-stampingDigiSign: Aadhaar eSign, and electronic signatures for compliant executionDigiCollect: Recurring payment collection via UPI, and eNACHDigiShield: Name screening and transaction monitoring for AML/CFT complianceCoTrust: DPDP-compliant consent management platformDigioLink: Account Aggregator for secure financial data sharingTogether, these products enable businesses to streamline onboarding, execute agreements, collect payments, and manage user consent in a compliant manner.Digio’s platform is designed for reliability, scalability, and ease of integration, supporting use cases across BFSI, fintech, digital assets, HR tech, and eCommerce.All products are accessible via APIs, SDKs, and no-code workflows, allowing businesses to go live quickly while meeting regulatory requirements.For business inquiries: support@digio.in
